children: SB Energy will deploy OpenAI tools across its workforce as the SoftBank-backed company expands its role in the Stargate AI infrastructure project

SoftBank-backed SB Energy plans to deploy OpenAI's artificial intelligence tools, including ChatGPT, for its employees as part of a broader partnership linked to the ambitious Stargate AI infrastructure project. The development highlights the growing adoption of generative AI within corporate workforces as companies increasingly integrate the technology into everyday business operations.

Under the partnership, SB Energy will use OpenAI's application programming interfaces (APIs) and make ChatGPT available to employees. The company is also expected to build and operate a 1.2-gigawatt data centre facility in Milam County, Texas, as part of the collaboration.

The employee deployment reflects how AI infrastructure investments are increasingly translating into workplace technology adoption, with businesses exploring ways to integrate AI into internal workflows, improve productivity and support operational efficiency.

The partnership comes amid heightened tensions between Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. Musk has publicly accused SoftBank of defaulting on payments for turbine orders linked to the Stargate project, although he has not provided details substantiating the allegation. SoftBank is among the major investors backing OpenAI and the proposed $500 billion AI infrastructure initiative.
The developments underline the growing intersection of AI infrastructure expansion and enterprise workforce transformation, as companies look to embed generative AI tools into employee workflows.
